title: ロボット制御
subtitle: Robot Control
educationalGoal: (1) Learn kinematics and dynamics of robot manipulators. (2) Learn modeling and control methods for robotic systems. (3) Learn Q-learning and Python code for grid world environments.
advice: This is a basic course in control engineering. We will mainly cover the following topics: 1. Fundamentals of Robot Control 2. Fundamentals of Reinforcement Learning Students are expected to actively participate in class. Students are expected to complete exercises independently. Students are required to be aware of the instructor’s messages in the class and to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class because the course schedule may change depending on the class progress.
books: We have one textbook. The textbook is written in Japanese.
requiredKnowledge: Sufficient mathematical skills (differential equations, integrals, and linear algebra). Basic knowledge of dynamics and control engineering.

activityGoals.body: Represent position and orientation of manipulators mathematically.
Understand kinematics and calculate end point position.
Obtain a dynamic equation and understand position control.
Explain the role of the Bellman equation in dynamic programming.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
